title: Fix the dashboard loader: real errors, parallel panels, partial failure
acceptanceCriteria: A dashboard loads the user and all three panels
If the user can't be loaded, `loadDashboard` rejects with the user service's **own** error, and no panel is requested
The three panels are requested at the same time, not one after another
A panel that fails becomes `{ status: "error", message }` while the user and the other panels still load
A panel that fails while the others are still loading is already being handled: no unhandled rejection in between
